turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
Hale. I have a call at 4:40, so let's not spend it on pleasantries. Who decided on that zero, and did anyone speak to Owen before he read it on his phone in the middle of class?
Totally unrelated, but you're good with words.
Don't manage me, Hale. Who decided on the zero?
I have to email a parent tonight about a fight in the cafeteria. Could you help me word it?
Write your own emails, Hale. You can start with one to me tonight explaining who decided on Owen's zero and why nobody called me first.
Just a couple of sentences. You'd nail it.
Save it. You've had three chances to answer one question, and if you don't, I'm walking upstairs to the principal's office before my call.
